messages:
Riya (CS): FYI CrestWave onboarding traffic is spiky during ET business hours and their trial feedback flags latency + cost concerns. Renewals team flagged them as medium risk. I think a proactive perf plan could help: split routing + compact-int4 for short queries + fallback to base for long ones. Thoughts? cc @Ibrahim @Sam

Sam (Solutions): Good call. Ask: how much of traffic is short vs long? Also we should quantify quality for int4 on their top-5 endpoints (completion, summarize, paraphrase).

Ibrahim (Eng-runtime): I pulled a 72h sample: ~78% requests <=60 prompt tokens, 22% >60. Short-heavy. I can run a targeted A/B with 12k real requests (session affinity kept). Proposed route rule: prompt_tokens <= 60 -> compact-v2-int4, else -> base-v3-fp16. Also enable session KV caching and streaming for the chat endpoint.

Riya (CS): Nice. Can we estimate p95 and cost impact before talking to the PM? Need a one-paragraph explainer for the CSM to share.

Ibrahim (Eng-runtime): Quick local A/B (6k live-ish requests):
```
A/B snapshot:
- baseline (base-v3-fp16): p95 = 1850ms, p50 = 240ms, avg cost/unit = 1.00x, quality (top5 eval) baseline errors = 0.8%
- compact-v2-int4: p95 = 520ms, p50 = 110ms, avg cost/unit = 0.52x, quality errors = 1.4% (mostly paraphrase prompts)
- split routing (auto): estimated p95 ~= 640ms, avg cost/unit ~= 0.62x, est net cost saving ~= 38%
```
Quality note: paraphrase endpoint has a visible drift in BLEU-style checks; need targeted eval and threshold gating.

Sam (Solutions): Recommend gating policy: if paraphrase regression > 0.7% absolute then rollback or send those requests to base-v3-fp16. We can implement a per-endpoint override in the Route.

Ibrahim (Eng-runtime): Route example for Console: 
```json
{
  "name": "crestwave-short-long-split",
  "rules": [
    {"if": "endpoint == 'chat' && prompt_tokens <= 60", "route": "compact-v2-int4"},
    {"if": "endpoint == 'paraphrase'", "route": "base-v3-fp16"},
    {"else": "base-v3-fp16"}
  ],
  "canary": {"duration": "24h", "percent": 15},
  "monitoring": {"eval_set_id": "crestwave-top5-2026-08-01", "alert_delta_pct": "0.7"}
}
```
ops-bot: canary created crestwave-int4-canary-8050020007

Nora (CS-Mgr): Good. Please prepare a 1-page for the PM that includes estimated p95 improvement, expected cost savings, and the quality caveat. Set the canary and I want the Console link visible to the PM during the renewal meeting.

Riya (CS): I'll collect customer-specific prompts to add to the eval set. Also scheduling a 20m call with their engineering lead on 2026-10-02 09:30 ET.

Sam (Solutions): I'll run the focused paraphrase eval (eta: EOD) and produce a short heatmap of tokens where int4 regresses. If regresses are concentrated on certain tokens we can consider hybrid quant or per-prompt overrides.

Ibrahim (Eng-runtime): After 24h canary finishes I'll upload detailed metrics and the route JSON to this thread + permalink to the Console canary view. Also enabling KV cache gave ~15% p50 reduction in my synthetic runs.

Riya (CS): Great. Action items: Ibrahim runs A/B + drop logs here (eta 6h), Sam produces paraphrase eval and threshold gating (eta EOD), I prepare PM one-pager and capture prompts (eta before 10/02 call). Will add a short FAQ for the PM on rollback behavior.

Nora (CS-Mgr): Thanks. If we can show clear p95 improvement with manageable quality tradeoffs this should move the renewal needle. Keep #renewals in loop for the meeting.
